page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut ornament at the head; a large title block in capitals and italics; then running text in one column with a historiated initial O at the start of the letter; a catchword "utili;" at the foot right; page number "2" at the foot centre with a printer's mark.

main_text.head: REVERENDISSIMO, IN CHRISTO, PATRI PATRICIO MISERATIONE DIVINA EPISCOPO ABERDONIENSI;
ACADEMIÆ ABERDONIENSIS CANCELLARIO & INSTAVRATORI:
main_text.p: Domino & Parenti meo honorandissimo, Salutem in DOMINO.
main_text.head: REVERENDISSIME PATER,
main_text.p: Uasdam de receptis ritibus Aporias Frater quidam combresbyter ad tenuitatem meam scriptas misit, enixè rogans ut titubanti succurrerem. Quod quia sincero addiscendæ Veritatis & tranquillandæ conscientiæ studio facere videbatur, protinus ei (invocato priùs scria ac supplice prece Nomine DOMINI) de propositis Aporiis breviter rescripsi. Autor verò mihi exstitit reverentia tua, ut nonnulla in aliorum etiam utili;
main_text.notes: The title block and the large initial O are printed; the initial is transcribed as "O" with the ornament omitted. The catchword "utili;" is at the foot right. The word "scria" reads as printed. The first paragraph opens with a historiated initial; the opening letter is given as the first word "Quod" is not separate. Doubtful: the initial letter of the paragraph is a large woodcut "O" and was read as the opening of "Uasdam" in the printed text; the printed text begins with "Uasdam" after the initial.
